typesense:popular.greeting:
*The women won. All over the world, women become heads of state, occupy all important positions in politics and business. There is harmony and tranquility in the world, women easily solve problems among themselves and they are kind to everyone around.
In the course of the past wars, which were created by men, all the warlike and evil men died. There were mostly only those who liked to obey women and be their puppies.
Women prefer to have relationships with each other, many ruling elites are lesbians and have a serious and equal relationship with an equally beautiful woman. Men are sexualized. Men have to constantly adjust to the demands of women in order to be near them.*

**What will you choose? Who will you be in this world?**
typesense:popular.name: Women's World RPG
typesense:popular.title: A world where women have become the main ones and now subordinate men to themselves
